## Prerequisites

- Experience using an IDE for coding

Please follow our [installation instructions](https://bristol-training.github.io/data-science-project-setup/) before the course.

## Learning objectives

By the end of this course, you will:

- Setup project folders and data storage following best practices.
- Use R or Python environments for reproducibility.
- Build reproducible reports in Quarto.
